import unittest
from unittest.mock import Mock
from loan import borrow_book

class MemberIdentityTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_missing_identity_never_creates_a_loan(self):
        members = [{"name": "Sam Reed"}, {"member_id": None}, {"member_id": ""}, {"member_id": " \t"}, {"member_id": 803}]
        for member in members:
            writer = Mock(return_value="loan-215")
            result = borrow_book(member, writer)
            writer.assert_not_called()
            self.assertEqual(result, {"status": "invalid", "error": "missing_member_id"})

    def test_writer_error_is_not_retried(self):
        member = {"member_id": "patron-803"}
        writer = Mock(side_effect=RuntimeError("loan rejected"))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "loan rejected"):
            borrow_book(member, writer)
        writer.assert_called_once_with(member)
